meta.title: QCS shows correct landed price when freight is non‑zero
gaps: Independently verify the separate freight value of 20 and that the displayed landed price was calculated as 80 + 20 rather than receiving the total from another source.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Independently verify the separate freight value of 20 and that the displayed landed price was calculated as 80 + 20 rather than receiving the total from another source.

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ directly on Master QCS.
Confirm the QCS contains Vendor A's bid column with a real vendor name.
Verify the QCS displays the API-held total for Vendor A, which represents the landed bid amount.
Verify Vendor A is ranked L1 when it has the lowest landed amount.
Confirm ranking follows the displayed total amount.
